outcome: Maternal cardiac complications (arrhythmia, congestive cardiac failure, thromboembolism, atrial fibrillation)
Maternal obstetric complications (postpartum hemorrhage, anemia, pregnancy-induced hypertension)
Fetal complications (preterm delivery, fetal growth restriction, intrauterine fetal death, congenital cardiac disease)
cohort: The study included 54 pregnancies complicated by pulmonary artery hypertension (PAH) in a tertiary care setting in North Eastern India.
finding: No maternal mortality was noted, but maternal complications and lower birth weight were significantly associated with a higher degree of PAH.
mod_finding: LSCS was the mode of delivery in the majority (77.7%) of cases.
birth_weight: Measured, found to be significantly lower with an increase in the severity of PAH.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 38 weeks and 5 days.
